beats.title: Leyden Jar Stores Electric Charge
beats.description: A glass jar lined with metal foil is found to hold a strong electric charge, the first device able to store electricity.
beats.why_in: first way of storing electric charge

beats.title: Volta Builds the Electric Pile
beats.description: Stacked discs of zinc and copper separated by brine-soaked cloth give the first steady, continuous electric current.

beats.title: Pixii's Hand-Cranked Dynamo
beats.description: A French instrument maker spins a magnet past coils of wire to build the first practical generator with a commutator.

beats.title: Daniell Cell Steadies the Battery
beats.description: A British chemist solves the hydrogen-bubble problem of early batteries with two liquids, giving a steadier, longer-lasting current.

beats.title: Grove Invents the Fuel Cell
beats.description: A Welsh scientist combines hydrogen and oxygen over platinum electrodes and draws an electric current from the reaction.
beats.note: Sources vary: first experiments 1838, published 1839, working gas battery 1842. Year it began used.

beats.title: Planté's Lead-Acid Battery
beats.description: A French physicist builds the first battery that can be recharged, using lead plates in acid, still the basis of car batteries.

beats.title: Siemens' Self-Excited Dynamo
beats.description: Werner Siemens shows that a generator can feed its own magnets, making powerful electricity affordable at scale.
beats.note: Discovered 1866; reported to the academy in early 1867.

beats.title: Gramme Dynamo Runs as a Motor
beats.description: A dynamo shown at a Vienna fair is found to run backwards as an electric motor when fed current from another machine.

beats.title: Godalming Lights Up with Hydropower
beats.description: A small English town runs a waterwheel-driven generator to supply street lamps, the first public electricity supply.
beats.note: First public supply, but not permanent; Brighton usually cited for first permanent.

beats.title: Pearl Street Station Opens
beats.description: Edison's Manhattan power plant begins sending electricity through underground wires to paying customers.

beats.title: Brush's Wind Turbine
beats.description: An Ohio inventor erects a giant windmill with a huge bladed wheel to charge batteries and power his mansion.
beats.why_in: first automatic wind turbine for electricity

beats.title: AC Lights the Chicago World's Fair
beats.description: Westinghouse powers a vast Chicago exposition with alternating current, winning the argument in the War of the Currents.

beats.title: Niagara Falls Generates AC Power
beats.description: Giant turbines at the falls feed Tesla and Westinghouse's alternating current system, later carrying power to distant cities.

beats.title: Jungner's Nickel-Cadmium Battery
beats.description: A Swedish engineer creates a rugged rechargeable cell using nickel and cadmium electrodes in an alkaline electrolyte.

beats.title: Larderello Geothermal Plant
beats.description: At an Italian volcanic steam field, Prince Ginori Conti runs a small engine on natural steam to light up a few bulbs.

beats.title: Lauchhammer-Riesa High-Voltage Line
beats.description: A German line running at 110,000 volts carries power more than 50 kilometres, then Europe's highest-voltage link.

beats.title: Britain Legislates a National Grid
beats.description: Parliament creates a Central Electricity Board to link the country's power stations with a grid of high-voltage lines.

beats.title: Britain's National Grid Goes Live
beats.description: Pylons carrying 132,000-volt lines link power stations into the world's first integrated national electricity network.
beats.note: National Grid dates commercial operation to 1935; construction 1927-33; single integrated operation from 1938.

beats.title: Smith-Putnam Turbine Feeds Grid
beats.description: A giant two-bladed turbine on a Vermont hilltop becomes the first megawatt-scale wind machine to supply a power grid.

beats.title: Bell Labs Unveils the Solar Cell
beats.description: Researchers show a silicon device that turns sunlight into useful electricity, the ancestor of modern solar panels.

beats.title: The Geysers Geothermal Plant Opens
beats.description: A Californian plant taps underground steam to feed a utility's grid, the start of large-scale geothermal power in America.

beats.title: The Great Northeast Blackout
beats.description: A faulty relay in Ontario cascades into a failure that plunges millions across the northeastern US and Canada into darkness.

beats.title: Rance Tidal Power Station Opens
beats.description: A French estuary barrage begins harnessing ocean tides to generate electricity, the world's first large tidal plant.

beats.title: Pacific DC Intertie Opens
beats.description: A direct-current line carries hydropower from the Pacific Northwest to Los Angeles, a milestone in long-distance transmission.

beats.title: White House Gets Solar Panels
beats.description: A US president has hot-water solar collectors installed on the presidential residence to promote renewable energy.
beats.note: Dedicated June 1979; panels produced hot water, not electricity.

beats.title: Crotched Mountain Wind Farm Starts
beats.description: Twenty turbines on a New Hampshire hillside form the first modern American wind farm, though the breezes disappoint.
beats.note: Disputed as world's first; first modern wind farm.

beats.title: Dinorwig Pumped Storage Station
beats.description: A Welsh power station hidden inside a mountain can release stored water in seconds to meet sudden surges in demand.

beats.title: Solar Storm Blacks Out Quebec
beats.description: A geomagnetic storm collapses a Canadian provincial grid in seconds, leaving millions without electricity.

beats.title: Lithium-Ion Battery Released
beats.description: Sony puts the first commercial rechargeable lithium-ion cell on sale, soon powering phones, laptops and electric cars.

beats.title: Toyota Prius Goes on Sale
beats.description: The first mass-produced hybrid car pairs a petrol engine with a battery and electric motor.

beats.title: LIMPET Wave Power Plant Connects
beats.description: A shoreline wave energy device on a Scottish island begins feeding electricity into the national grid.

beats.title: The Great Northeast Blackout
beats.description: A tree-touched power line in Ohio triggers a cascade that darkens cities from New York to Toronto.

beats.title: Tesla Roadster Reaches Customers
beats.description: A sports car powered by thousands of laptop-style cells shows that electric vehicles can be fast and desirable.

beats.title: Tesla Powerwall Unveiled
beats.description: A wall-mounted home battery is launched to store rooftop solar power and back up households during outages.

beats.title: Hornsdale Power Reserve Switches On
beats.description: The world's biggest lithium-ion battery at the time starts stabilising South Australia's grid, built in about 100 days.

beats.title: Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm Opens
beats.description: Hundreds of turbines off the Yorkshire coast begin sending power ashore from what was then the largest offshore wind farm.
beats.note: First power February 2019; fully commissioned late 2019 or 2020 depending on source.

beats.title: Iberian Peninsula Blackout
beats.description: A sudden collapse of the grid leaves Spain and Portugal without electricity for hours, halting trains and shutting shops.
